purpose: Offline animal photo catalog; UI-only integration, no published content feed change.
sourceEvidence: Exact source-page HTML snapshots and original/downloaded bytes retained locally at /tmp/mather-tv-fun-20261003/animal-originals. Immutable sourceRevisionID, sourcePageSHA256 and individual grant notes are recorded here.
derivativePolicy: Never upscale; aspect-fit in UI. No app crop, retouching or generated detail in included photos. JPEG quality 78; long edge bounded at 1600.
hashPolicy: originalSHA256 is null when original bytes were rate limited. downloadedSHA256 always identifies the actual original or supported Commons thumbnail used; derivativeSHA256 identifies the bundled JPEG.
contentPolicy: India wildlife membership refers to a species found in India, not the photograph location. Sheep is generic, farm-only. Facts are taxonomy and visually verified features; no invented habitat/lifespan/weight claims.
